title: Power Automate: view property values inline on cards in the new cloud flow designer
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's maker-selected inline view and side-pane default. The Layout route is supported across the two cited designer articles, and the page appropriately distinguishes that documented layout control from the roadmap's runtime-value view.

claims.claim: The maker Layout control is reached through My flows > Cloud flows > flow > Edit > New designer (on) > Collapse (configuration pane) > Layout, using the two cited articles.
claims.quote: New designer toggle: Switch between the new designer and the classic designer. Collapse button: (New designer only) Hide the pane. The buttons appear at the bottom-left corner of the canvas when the configuration pane is closed. Layout: Switch between inline and panel layouts.

claims.claim: The beginning of the Layout route, absent from the designer overview, is documented in the cited Use data operations article.
claims.quote: On the navigation pane to the left, select My flows. In the Cloud flows tab, select the flow you want to open. On the command bar at the top, select Edit. The flow opens in the designer.

claims.claim: No automation equivalent for selecting the maker's inline or panel Layout is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate Layout inline API PowerShell tenant settings; Power Platform API cloud flow designer inline layout tenant environment settings pac admin. Read flows-designer, pac admin and Set-TenantSettings search excerpts; no layout operation found.

claims.claim: No tenant or environment administrator switch or API for this inline property-value view is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Power Automate inline property output values cloud flow designer Layout tenant environment administrator switch API PowerShell pac setting. Read flows-designer and search excerpts for pac admin, pac power-automate, Power Apps PowerShell and Set-TenantSettings; no view-specific switch found.

claims.claim: The documented panel layout displays properties in the configuration pane and keeps cards compact.
claims.quote: The panel layout displays the properties in the configuration pane on the left and keeps the action cards compact.
